title: Fitness and health center

paragraphs.text: Now we shall begin. You should answer the questions as you listen because you will not hear the recording a second time. Listen carefully and answer questions one to six.
Good morning. Health and Fitness Center.
Oh, good morning. Uh, I was thinking of joining the center, but I'd like to find out a bit more about your facilities first. For example, what are your opening hours?
Well, we open every day at seven AM and close at eleven PM during the week and nine thirty at weekends.
Right. And how much does membership cost?
Is this for yourself?
Well, probably for my wife as well, and maybe the children. It depends.
Well, for one adult, the charge is a hundred and 55 pounds a year, but for family membership, that's two adults and up to two children, it's 285 pounds.
Okay. Well, that doesn't sound too bad. Right. Now, we actually live quite near, but with the children, I expect we'd be driving there. So what's the situation about parking?
That's free for our members, and there's always plenty of space.
Okay. Well, that's certainly something to think about. We've been thinking of joining a fitness center for a bit, but we've never got around to it.
Well, these membership charges are fixed until August, but in September, they could go up. So I'd recommend that if you are interested, you join straight away.
Hmm. Well, it does depend a bit on what facilities you have. One thing we're all very keen on is swimming, for example.
Right. Well, there are two pools. The main pool is lovely. It's twenty-five meters, and the roof is all made of glass, so you get lots of natural light. And there's a separate pool for children.
What about the gym?

Well, if you become a member, you get a session for orientation on the cardio and weights equipment in the gym given by one of our qualified staff. That normally costs fifteen pounds per person, so it's a very good deal. And one thing that's very popular is there's TV installed on some of the equipment, so you can watch as you work out.
Okay.
Before you hear the rest of the conversation, you have some time to look at questions seven to ten on page three.
Now listen and answer questions seven to ten.
Now, we do also have a program of evening classes. I don't know if you'd like me to give you any information about them at this stage.
Sure.
Well, I'll just give you a few examples now, but do ask if there's anything in particular you're interested in. For example, our Monday squash class is very popular.
I've never played it, but I'd like to learn. So is it aimed at beginners?
Yes, that's right.
Okay. Well, I might well be interested.
Then on Tuesdays, we do judo. We have different classes suitable for all levels. The only requirement is that you're over sixteen. I'm afraid we can't cater for anyone younger than that at present.
No problem. What about yoga? I know my wife's keen to take that up again.
We have a class on Wednesdays. I take it she's not a beginner.
No. In fact, she used to be at advanced level, but she's probably a bit rusty as she hasn't done any for a few years now.
Well, the Wednesday class is for intermediate students, so it might be okay for her. She can try it out for one lesson to see and then sign up if she thinks it's going to suit her.
Thanks. I'll let her know.
And I don't know if either you or your wife would be interested, but we do have classes on Thursday evenings for people interested in improving their diet as a way of staying healthy.
Hmm. Well, I suppose we both might be, but it would depend what time.
Well, there's one class at six thirty PM, but it's full up, so we're opening a new one at eight thirty the same evening.
Right. Well, that would be better for us, actually. I'll talk to my wife. So if we want to join-
That is the end of section one. You now have half a minute to check your answers.
